I need to determine how many NHANES cycles included the measurement of PFOA (variable name LBXPFOA).

PFOA (Perfluorooctanoic acid) with the variable name LBXPFOA has been measured in the following NHANES cycles:

1. 2003–2004
2. 2005–2006
3. 2007–2008
4. 2009–2010
5. 2011–2012
6. 2013–2014
7. 2015–2016
8. 2017–2018

Note: Starting with the 2017-2018 cycle onward, NHANES transitioned to using different variable names (such as LBXPFOA being replaced or restructured), and the 2017-2018 cycle still used LBXPFOA. The pre-pandemic 2017–March 2020 cycle may also be considered, but the specific variable name LBXPFOA was used across these cycles.

The answer is **8**.
